name: comp-217
title: Inset Label Select
blurb: Select with label inset at top, unified container border.
description: A select wrapped in a bordered container with the label inside at the top edge. Transparent trigger removes its own border for a unified appearance.
use_when: You want a modern, Material Design-inspired inset label style with clear focus states.
avoid_when: When a simpler label placement is sufficient or for constrained layouts.
a11y: Label is inset but properly associated via htmlFor; focus ring visible.
